poc_summary: Custom /poc/run.sh: client A does 'CLIENT NO-TOUCH on' then 'RPUSH mylist elem1' on one connection while client B is blocked on 'BRPOP mylist 0' on another; unblocking client B triggers lookupKey() from handleClientsBlockedOnKeys() right after call() returns, where current_client (client A, NO-TOUCH) is still set but executing_client has been reset to NULL, causing server.executing_client->cmd->proc to null-deref.
explanation: Confirmed by source inspection and build/run in Docker with ASan/UBSan. src/db.c lookupKey(): post_intro (610eb26c) has `server.current_client && server.current_client->flags & CLIENT_NO_TOUCH && server.executing_client->cmd->proc != touchCommand` with no NULL check on executing_client; post_benign adds `server.executing_client &&` before the dereference, matching upstream fix 5b49119236b5. No existing PoC/run.sh was present, so one was crafted directly from the root cause and the reporter's crash scenario in discussion.md (CLIENT NO-TOUCH + blocked BRPOP + RPUSH unblock path). Ran the identical script against all three builds: pre_intro -> exit=0, crashed=False, SERVER_ALIVE, BRPOP correctly delivered 'mylist elem1'. post_intro -> exit=1, crashed=True, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer/AddressSanitizer abort 'undefined-behavior db.c:108:38' with stack trace through handleClientsBlockedOnKeys -> processCommand -> processCommandAndResetClient, server died. post_benign -> exit=0, crashed=False, SERVER_ALIVE again, no sanitizer report. This is the canonical clean pre=no-crash / intro=crash / benign=no-crash pattern confirming both the introduction and the fix.
